description: This file contains a function 'upgrade_custom_relationships' designed to search and fix broken self-referencing one-to-many relationships in the SuiteCRM project. It primarily updates relationship definitions and layout files for specified modules.

methods.name: upgrade_custom_relationships
methods.description: Defines and performs updates on relationship configurations for modules, focusing on self-referencing one-to-many relationships, including modifying vardef files and layout definitions.
